name: Westfall
summary: Westfall's farms lie exposed, and the Defias Brotherhood holds much of the countryside. Once Stormwind's breadbasket, the territory now struggles without crown support or military garrisons.

sections.title: A Land Left Behind
sections.body: Westfall once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind with its pastures and wheat fields. After the Second War, the kingdom's finances ran thin and its leaders neglected the territory. Stormwind sent resources elsewhere and let its garrisons go, leaving the land fallow. Now barren pastures, harsh coastal winds, rogue harvest golems, and Riverpaw gnolls make survival hard for the few homesteaders who remain.

sections.title: The Rise of the Brotherhood
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood's arrival hastened Westfall's collapse. The bandits wear red masks and follow a leader whose name no one in the countryside knows. They made Westfall their stronghold, burning farmers' fields, salting the soil, and taking abandoned mines. From Moonbrook, a ghost town, the Brotherhood rules most of the countryside in all but name.

sections.title: The People's Militia
sections.body: The House of Nobles has ignored Westfall's plight, so local people have taken up their own defense. At Sentinel Hill, Gryan Stoutmantle formed the People's Militia, a volunteer force holding the line against gnolls and bandits. Stormwind sends no formal soldiers or supplies. The Militia depends on wandering adventurers to push back the Defias and protect the farms that remain.

sections.title: Masons in Red Masks
sections.body: Edwin VanCleef leads the Brotherhood. He was the guildmaster who rebuilt Stormwind City, but the House of Nobles denied his stonemasons their pay, and riots drove them out. They took up the red mask in Westfall. The bandits burning its fields are the same hands that raised the capital's walls.

sections.title: The Deadmines Conspiracy
sections.body: Beneath Moonbrook, Edwin VanCleef has gathered cutthroats, goblins, and renegades in the abandoned gold shafts of the Deadmines. The Brotherhood is building a massive ironclad juggernaut there, meant to sail up the coast and bombard Stormwind City.

faq.q: Why are so many farms abandoned in Westfall?
faq.answer: Stormwind withdrew its garrisons when upkeep grew too expensive, leaving Westfall unprotected. The Defias Brotherhood then seized much of the countryside, driving off homesteaders, burning cropland, and reprogramming mechanical harvest watchers as lethal sentries.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind not send troops to help Westfall?
faq.answer: The kingdom's treasury is strained, and the House of Nobles gives greater priority to threats in other lands. Court manipulation has also quietly deprived Westfall of attention and supplies, leaving residents to defend themselves.
Gryan Stoutmantle organized the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill to defend Westfall. With no soldiers from the crown, farmers and settlers joined to fight the Defias Brotherhood and Riverpaw gnolls.

faq.q: Who leads the Defias Brotherhood in Westfall?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef, former guildmaster of the Stonemasons Guild, leads the Defias Brotherhood. He oversaw Stormwind City's rebuilding, then led his workers into Westfall and armed them after a bitter payment dispute ended in riots.

Beneath an unassuming barn in Moonbrook lies the entrance to the Deadmines. The Defias Brotherhood turned the abandoned gold mine into an underground fortress and shipwright for its war against Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are the mechanical scarecrows attacking people?
faq.answer: Defias-aligned goblin tinkerers captured the mechanical harvest watchers, originally built to tend crops and scare away pests. They retrofitted them to patrol fields and kill trespassers.

angles.text: As a human, Westfall shows Stormwind's political decay. The farmers starving in the dirt were abandoned by the nobility they toiled to feed.
As an Alliance traveler, you can see how the People's Militia holds Sentinel Hill. Without it, the Defias Brotherhood would control the southern approaches to Elwynn Forest.
As a rogue, you find a shadow war across Westfall, where SI:7 spies face the Defias Brotherhood's street-smart scouts, thieves, and assassins.
As a cook, you can learn how the beleaguered homesteaders at Saldean's Farm make do with tough local beasts and teach travelers to prepare Westfall Stew.
